extracted.intended_audience: C.I.G. administrative staff and participating departmental personnel responsible for sending, receiving, and processing cables
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative procedure for procuring, delivering, securing, accounting for, and distributing departmental cables within the C.I.G.; includes trial implementation and assignment of responsibility for carrying out required actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectives of the order
rubrics_metrics.description: The objectives of this order are to establish a uniform system for the procurant, delivery, security and accounting of departmental cables to CIG; to reduce as much as possible the administration incident to the other cables, and to expedite the flow of cables to those who require them in the performance of their duty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets overall goals: uniformity of system, reduction of administrative burden, and expedited delivery to recipients; use these objectives to guide all subsequent procedural decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniform system for procurement, delivery, security and accounting
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a uniform system for the procuring, delivery, security and accounting of departmental cables to CIG.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procurement, delivery, security controls, and accounting practices for cables should be standardized across participating departments to reduce variability and administrative overhead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize administrative incident to cables
rubrics_metrics.description: To reduce as much as possible the administration incident to the other cables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures should be designed to limit unnecessary paperwork, duplication, and administrative handling of cables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expedite flow of cables to required recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: To expedite the flow of cables to those who require them in the performance of their duty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize timely transmission and delivery so that personnel who need cable information receive it without delay; timeliness is a core performance metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial implementation and effective date
rubrics_metrics.description: The particulars of this order will be put into effect on a trial at C8G3, 17 December 1946.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement procedures initially on a trial basis at the designated unit and evaluate before broader rollout; track start date and trial scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial procurement and handling of copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Initially, copies of cables will be procured and handled in [compartments/localities] as indicated below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify where and how initial physical or record copies are to be procured and handled; follow the later detailed compartmental handling instructions (referenced but not fully reproduced here).

rubrics_metrics.name: OCU responsibility for initiating necessary actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Action to effect necessary [changes] will be initiated by OCU as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OCU (Office/Unit named) is responsible for initiating whatever actions are necessary to implement or adjust the procedures; designate clear responsibility for operational changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Department-of-origin instructions override default distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise specified by the department of origin, each cable is available for distribution within CIG in accordance with ODG needs, subject only to established security procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the originating department imposes distribution restrictions, those must be respected; otherwise distribute internally according to organizational needs within security constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution according to internal needs (subject to security)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each cable is available for distribution within CIG in accordance with ODG needs, subject only to established security procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Internal distribution should be driven by operational needs (ODG) but must always conform to established security controls; balance accessibility with security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to established security procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution and handling are subject only to established security procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All handling, copying, procurement, delivery and distribution activities must follow pre-existing security procedures; security rules are the limiting constraint on access and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accounting and record-keeping for cables
rubrics_metrics.description: Accounting of departmental cables to CIG (part of the stated objectives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain records of procurement, delivery, copies, and distribution of cables to ensure an auditable accounting trail; accounting is part of the uniform system requirement.
